questions.Q2: slice 2 / S7-M1: given a signed Q1 delta, design a `partially-extracted` SourceExtraction outcome carrying items+denominators for the succeeded classes and a per-class failure record for the failed ones. Default: a tenth category stays invisible.
questions.Q4: slice 4 / L1-M4: declare root-independence per tree rule (a rootIndexRequired flag + rule provenance), so a root-dependent rule's sources stay counted-and-Unknown when the root is unread and a root-independent population is stamped with an aggregate qualification. Arms: (a) no change; (b) declare independence + render the qualification; (c) qualify only, no admission change. Default: Rules 3-4 stay root-blind.
